svg.title: ReWatch(Iot) hardware architecture with animated data flow
svg.desc: Animated illustration. A LAN switch sends a mirrored SPAN or TAP feed to a Raspberry Pi 3 Sentinel that writes USB evidence; Ethernet and MQTT telemetry reach a Raspberry Pi 4 Core hosting broker, scoring and dashboard; the operator laptop exchanges HTTP and WebSocket traffic with Core; a RED incident travels to a Raspberry Pi 3 Herald which attempts SMTP to a relay, where acceptance does not prove delivery; Core feeds an enclosure over serial by default or optional MQTT to an ESP32-C3 with an OLED and colour LED, while an ESP32-WROOM Black Hat rig talks plain Wi-Fi MQTT. Packets move along every path to show how data travels. Vector illustration of the documented hardware, not photographs.
svg.text: ReWatch(Iot) / hardware architecture — live data flow
Animated: follow the coloured packets to see how data travels between the boards.
Vector illustration of the documented hardware — not photographs. Black Hat WROOM rig models rooms in software (no mains wiring).
* C3: serial default; optional MQTT has payload/fleet limits. SMTP accepted ≠ delivery · responses are requests, not proof of actuation.
